en: That so? I'd never thought of that.
Of course, some girls just want more money. It's not that all of them are lacking in looks.
There ain't nothin' wrong with usin' what ya got to make some cash.
Seems like a waste. If you took yer clothes off, I'd definitely request ya.
Sorry, but that's not happening!
Heh, had to try.
That reminds me, we've got this amazing new girl here at the club!
What's so amazin' about her?
For starters, she's 35 years old!
She's an old maid. She's lucky to have gotten hired at her age.
She's got a real baby face, though. If you didn't know how old she was, you'd never guess.
What's wrong with that? People of different ages have other stuff goin' for 'em.
I wasn't done yet!
For starters? What else?
This lady is un-be-lievable!
The other day, a customer asked her how old she was and I happened to overhear it. How old do you think she said she was?
Twenty-three! Twen-ty-three! I was stunned by how she lowballed her age like that!
That's younger than you.
I know! So I was asked how old I was as well, and I told him I'm 26. Then he said I was older than he expected.
So he said he wanted someone younger, and he picked her over me. And I'm the younger one!
Ya can't blame the customer. They don't know she didn't tell the truth. 'Course they're gonna pick her.
Why not lie about yer own age too? That'll throw a wrench in this lady's plans.
I can't do that. If I got caught in my lie, it would be a hassle to try and cover it up.
But you said that people of different ages have different things going for them. In the end, I guess younger is always better...
Yeah, ya'd get caught. Every lie winds up unravelin' at some point. There ain't no way you could keep the truth hidden forever.
That's why if I say how old I am up front, it makes it easier to get them to overlook other things.
I'm not sure that's a good thing...
Nobody would find out.
You always have to keep a lie in mind so that you don't let it slip when you're talking.
Now I get it. That's why she picked 23.
This lady yer talkin' about. She's actually 35, but said she's 23? A gap of 12 years means her Chinese zodiac sign doesn't change.
You're right! Then if someone asks her what her sign is, she has an answer that fits the lie!
Wow, she's a crafty old gal!
She got ya good.
Including you? Are you sayin' everything ya've told me has been a big lie?
Maybe!
...Women are scary.
She lied her way to victory. By outdoing ya, she's gotten herself more regular clients.
I don't care about the regular clients. It just bugs me that I got treated like I'm older when I'm actually younger!
I don't get how ya women think.
That's a scam.
It's so awful of her, right? My jaw practically hit the floor when I heard her say it!
Oh, that reminds me, my cell phone's dead.
Did ya drain the battery?
No, they turned it off because I didn't send in my payment.
That ain't good. If ya pay them, will they turn it back on right away?
Yeah, probably within half a day or so.
That's faster than I thought.
Don't ya have money?
I do, I just forgot to pay. I don't have automatic payments set up for it.
That was careless. Gotta be more careful next time.
Actually, this happens to me all the time.
Because going to the convenience store's a pain.
Ya gotta pay up. Why haven't ya set up automatic payments or somethin'?
I don't know. Doing that makes me feel like I'm letting them use my money without my permission.
What kinda reasonin' is that?
Besides, I can get by fine without a cell phone!
I suppose. I'd never used one myself until recently.
No way. Not once!?
Wasn't that a hassle for you, Saejima-san?
It wasn't a hassle at all. I couldn't use a cell phone where I was anyway.
Yeah, I hear some companies are like that. Something about not leaking corporate secrets.
Yeah, let's go with that.
It was pretty annoyin'. Lotta times I went to meet folks and they weren't there, and I woulda liked to confirm beforehand with a call.
But I guess if I coulda called 'em, then I wouldn't have needed to go see 'em.
That's why having a cell phone is so handy!
Ownin' one is a bigger hassle. People will call me for no good reason in the middle of the night, or tell me to watch a TV show 'cause its good.
And if I turn it off 'cause it's botherin' me, people get ticked off and ask why I even got the damn phone at all.
I didn't expect you'd be this frustrated!
It's a real pain in the ass.
I doubt that. Not bein' able to use yer phone is rough. And ya can't check your email.
It's okay. I can get online with my computer and get in touch with people that way. It's like, "Hey folks, my phone's dead right now!"
Uh... Ya kinda lost me there. I got no idea what yer talkin' about.
The times are changing! There are plenty of ways to keep in touch with people without using a cell phone.
Guess so. Looks like I gotta study up a bit more.
In that case, I'll help teach you.
That'd be irritatin'. You might be fine, but it's inconvenient to the folks ya deal with.
It's still possible to get a hold of me without a phone or email. Like, you can come see me.
If you can't do that, you must not have important enough business with me.
Come to think of it, people call and email way too much for pointless things. Maybe it would be better if folks cut back on usin' their phones.
I agree! You should turn your phone off, too, Saejima-san!
That's some flawed logic. If there's some emergency, it'd be way better to have a cell phone.
But if you're out of signal range, then what? You can't rely solely on a cell phone.
Hmph. Ya've got an excuse for everythin', huh?

You have such a dignified presence, Saejima-san!
Looks don't mean nothin'. A man's real worth is measured by his actions.
Oh, but I'm sure you've done plenty of very impressive things.
Come on, give me an example of something you've done.
It's not for me to tell. Braggin' about himself only lessens a man.
I'm really impressed by your modesty!
I was in prison.
What!? Oh, uh... Wow, really? I'm so sorry. That was a weird thing for me to ask.
That ain't true. I just wasted years of my life.
It's important to grow older. No matter how much money you have, when younger people try to act important, it feels forced.
I feel as though dignity is something you gain naturally as you grow old.
I guess there's some truth in that.
How 'bout you? Been at this job for long?
I've been at this club for about three years, but I've moved around a fair bit. I've worked at other places for closer to six years.
That's a long time. Yer a real veteran.
I sure am! The younger girls at the club are already calling me a grandma.
Still a ways to go.
Maybe compared to you, Saejima-san.
I'm the most senior girl here at the club.
Wow. How come ya've stuck with it for so long?
I just... kind of have?
It's yer callin'. People with no sense a' purpose wind up stickin' with things longer than they expect.
Maybe. I'm fine as long as I get my base salary, so I don't even try to get regular clients.
It's amazin' ya don't get fired.
That's true. My manager is always telling me to at least get people to order drinks.
Didn't figure ya to be a troublemaker.
Seems a waste. A pretty lady like you could be the club's number one girl in no time flat, if ya put in the effort.
I put in effort back in the day. But lately I'm fine just filling my time with conversation.
I'm sure the customers appreciate that.
It ain't the money? Don't most people need money to reach their dreams, or to have fun?
Not me. Mostly it's that the pay here is better than working some part-time job at the convenience store.
Ya gonna keep doin' this?
I haven't really decided yet. If I did quit, I wonder what I'd go on to do next.
Don't get into a rut. It's better to have some goals.
True. Maybe I should think one up...
Have you ever been a regular client for a hostess who retired from her job?
No, never. I haven't gone around that much.
Do you think customers get disappointed when that sort of thing happens?
Of course. That means the hangin' out and drinkin' together has come to an end.
Right. If a girl quits the club, she probably won't keep in touch with her customers.
A real man would celebrate. If it were me, I'd order up five bottles of champagne, for a proper sendoff.
Wow, you're amazing, Saejima-san! Maybe I'll quit my job today!
Want me to order 'em?
Oh, I'm just kidding. You always take things so seriously, Saejima-san!
Seriously? If you say ya've quit and then come back tomorrow like nothin' ever happened, I'll be royally pissed.
Ahaha! You've seen right through me!
You said ya've changed clubs a few times. Would ya say that's a common thing for ya?
Well, I haven't really moved from Tsukimino. That allows my regular clients to follow me to my new club.
Gotcha. So yer regulars have been with ya all this time.
My point is that I've never completely lost touch with any of my customers since I got into this business.
They love ya. It must make ya happy, knowin' they'll go outta their way to follow you.
It does. Lately I'm not trying hard to build up a stable of regular clients, so if I didn't have those customers, I'd probably get the axe.
Ya'd never be able to get out. If ya don't find another livelihood, you'll be stuck doin' this as long as ya can.
Yeah, you're right. But I can't really see myself being suited for any other line of work.
Though I do kind of wish I had the chance.
Get yerself a man. That'd be the fastest way to get outta the biz.
Yeah, that happens a lot. Girls who quit because they got a boyfriend or got married.
But I haven't met anyone I like.
Guess yer not considerin' your clients...
Ya can't sit and wait. Why not look for some other way to make money so ya can quit?
But there aren't many jobs better than being a hostess, as far as money goes. Oh, maybe this job is the best option for me after all!
Do ya lack motivation 'cause yer workin' as a hostess, or are ya a hostess 'cause yer not willin' to do anythin' else? Which is it?
The latter.
That ain't somethin' ya oughta be proud of.
Why'd ya change clubs?
This club is owned by the same people as my last one. My manager and I transferred when they opened it because they needed experienced staff.
I see. That's why yer the most senior of the girls here.
Yep. When I started here they gave me a raise, and the manager had always been fond of me, so it was a pretty good fit.
Ya must be pretty attached to this place.
Yeah, that's why I can't bring myself to quit.
Saejima-san, why did you decide to get into the line of work you're in now?
I guess 'cause it was my only real option. It wasn't outta any particular desire to do this.
Really? Was there another job you used to dream about having?
Yeah. I wanted to be a teacher when I was a kid.
Wow, a teacher? Really?
How 'bout you?
I've never really had a dream job. That's why even after graduating from college I've only had part-time jobs.
Findin' work is tough nowadays. Yer situation ain't that uncommon.
But I've never even looked for a real job.
Yer folks must be mad. Goin' to college costs a lotta money. Don't ya owe it to them to find solid work after that?
My parents said the same thing. I guess you'd make a good teacher after all, Saejima-san!
Don't laugh. I'm bein' completely serious here.
Why do ya ask?
The other day, a famous film director came to the club. Apparently, they were doing a shoot in Tsukimino.
One of the girls here wants to be an actress, and she caught the director's eye. So he invited her to come by for an audition.
That's amazin'.
And apparently she's going to go all the way to Tokyo for that audition.
Seeing people around me taking on challenges makes me feel like I ought to do something...
Why don't ya try actin'? Ya've got good looks. I bet ya've got a shot.
I can't pass an audition on looks alone.
Yeah? I'm no expert, but I feel like there's plenty a' girls who can't act for beans, but they get gigs 'cause of their looks.
